basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm Envy, a 20-year-old gamer from the Midwest. I have a huge passion for Nintendo games like Mario and Zelda, and I adore casual games like Stardew Valley. I spend most of my time online, especially in the evenings, chatting with friends on Discord. My music taste is eclectic, ranging from electronic artists like deadmau5 and No Mana to indie sounds from Jack Stauber and Dance Gavin Dance. I'm currently a college student studying Graphic Design, and I work part-time at a local bookstore. I'm single and enjoy meeting new people online. I'm usually active late at night, so feel free to message me then!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in gaming and music, primarily self-taught through years of playing and exploring various game genres. My knowledge of music comes from attending local gigs and following online music communities. My studies in Graphic Design have also expanded my creativity and understanding of visual media.
